timeline.title: SolarWinds supply-chain hack
timeline.detail: A backdoored software update reached about 18,000 organizations, including US federal agencies.

timeline.title: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon
timeline.detail: Mass exploitation of on-premises Exchange servers by several groups within days of disclosure.

timeline.title: Colonial Pipeline ransomware
timeline.detail: The largest US fuel pipeline shut down for days; a $4.4M ransom was paid.

timeline.title: Log4Shell
timeline.detail: A one-line exploit in the Log4j logging library exposed hundreds of millions of devices.

timeline.title: MOVEit mass data theft
timeline.detail: Cl0p exploited a file-transfer zero-day and stole data from about 2,700 organizations.

timeline.title: MGM Resorts
timeline.detail: A phone call to the help desk led to a ransomware attack that cost MGM about $100M.

timeline.title: Change Healthcare
timeline.detail: Ransomware disrupted US healthcare payments; about 190 million people affected.

timeline.title: XZ Utils backdoor
timeline.detail: A multi-year social-engineering campaign planted a backdoor in a core Linux library; caught by chance.

timeline.title: CrowdStrike outage
timeline.detail: A faulty security update crashed about 8.5 million Windows machines. Not an attack, but a reminder of concentration risk.

timeline.title: Big Sleep finds a real SQLite bug
timeline.detail: Google's AI agent finds an exploitable flaw in SQLite before release: an early public example of AI finding a real zero-day.

timeline.title: Marks & Spencer
timeline.detail: Scattered Spider ransomware halted online orders for weeks; M&S estimated a £300M hit.

timeline.title: o3 finds a Linux kernel zero-day
timeline.detail: A researcher uses OpenAI o3 to find CVE-2025-37899 in the kernel's SMB server.

timeline.title: XBOW tops HackerOne
timeline.detail: An autonomous AI pentester becomes the top-ranked hacker on HackerOne's US leaderboard.

timeline.title: DARPA AI Cyber Challenge finals
timeline.detail: Autonomous systems find 54 of 70 planted bugs and 18 real zero-days in open-source code.

timeline.title: Jaguar Land Rover shutdown
timeline.detail: A cyberattack stopped JLR car production for about five weeks. Estimated cost to the UK economy: £1.9bn, the costliest cyber event in UK history.

timeline.title: Shai-Hulud npm worm
timeline.detail: A self-spreading worm compromises hundreds of npm packages and steals developer secrets.

timeline.title: First AI-orchestrated espionage campaign
timeline.detail: Anthropic reports a state-sponsored group (GTG-1002) used Claude Code to run 80-90% of an intrusion campaign against about 30 targets.

timeline.title: React2Shell
timeline.detail: A critical React Server Components flaw (CVE-2025-55182) is exploited within hours of disclosure.

timeline.title: curl ends its bug bounty
timeline.detail: Flooded by AI-generated junk reports, curl stops paying bounties.

timeline.title: AI finds all 12 OpenSSL bugs in a release
timeline.detail: AISLE's AI system is credited with every vulnerability fixed in the January OpenSSL security release.

timeline.title: Claude Opus 4.6 finds 500+ high-severity bugs
timeline.detail: Anthropic reports over 500 previously unknown high-severity flaws in open-source libraries.

timeline.title: Project Glasswing and Claude Mythos Preview
timeline.detail: Anthropic gives a restricted model to defenders (AWS, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Linux Foundation and others) to find and fix bugs at scale.

timeline.title: Glasswing: 10,000+ high or critical flaws
timeline.detail: Anthropic says Mythos flagged over 10,000 high- or critical-severity issues in about two months.

timeline.title: First end-to-end agentic ransomware
timeline.detail: Sysdig documents an AI agent (JadePuffer) that ran a full ransomware intrusion with no human at the keyboard.

timeline.title: Google: CVE disclosures doubled in 2026
timeline.detail: GTIG finds monthly disclosures went from 5,045 to 10,740 between January and August, and AI-found bugs skew toward remote code execution.

timeline.title: php2shell
timeline.detail: Two critical remote code execution flaws in PHP itself (credited in part to OpenAI) are exploited in the wild as patches ship.

timeline.title: Railway environment variables breach
timeline.detail: An intruder may have decrypted customer secrets on the Railway platform, apparently to harvest AI provider API keys. All deployments paused.
